alerts.title: Phoenix Cyclops Is Available Now as Marvel Tokon Receives Major PS5 Patch
alerts.summary: Born again. The first post-launch DLC character for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is now available. Phoenix Cyclops joins the fun today, 2nd November 2026, and he's accompanied by a major game update that makes a ton of improvements. Those who own the Year 1 Pass will already have access to Phoenix Cyclops, but he's also available as a standalone purchase, costing $7.99/£6.49. Read the full article on pushsquare.com
